answer: Audits are recorded in oasis, queued in orchard, and garden publishes the wait time. A farm of 302 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 85 identities per epoch. A farm of 3542 identities would post 4798 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
